title: shape state should only be persisted to undo/redo once it is committed. i.e. rotating a shape adds every single intermediary location to the undo/redo, but we should only persist the position once drag ends, instead of during the entire rotation
(fix) our bounding should move along with our object when rotating
Resize handles operate in screen space, not element-local space for rotated elements
description: Follow-up to pixi-editor-dfh. With the selection box now rotating with the element, resize handles for a rotated element drag along world axes instead of the element's local axes. TransformController.handleResize applies the world dx/dy directly to el.x/y/width/height; it should rotate the delta by -el.rotation into element-local space (and keep the anchor corner fixed in world space) so resize tracks the dragged handle correctly when rotation != 0.
